definition: Felt through another person’s actions rather than one’s own direct experience.
book: The Strange Case of Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde
author: Robert Louis Stevenson
quote: When I would come back from these excursions, I was often plunged into a kind of wonder at my vicarious depravity.
example_sentence: I get a vicarious thrill from watching cooking shows.
